facts.name: Spicy Joi’s Banh Mi & Lao Street Food
facts.label: Spicy Joi’s
facts.tagline: Chef Joi’s fast-casual Lao street food in the 99 Ranch plaza on Willow Pass Road, Concord: banh mi, Oua Lao sausage, handmade khaopiak, papaya salad and the King’s Platter.
